scope: Previously exposed BotFails development data, not held-out accuracy. Automatic full-frame green-region proposals require source inspection for plate identity. No object poses, attachment or destination geometry.
basis: Broad color prior from the task concept green plate; engineering screens, not calibrated probabilities. Unchanged source-feature correspondence and .25/.5-second policy imported from unified_workflow. Association is camera-local only and ends on every missing/ambiguous match. Red mask is robot-colored context, NEVER a gripper pose. No event timestamp, outcome label, ROI or destination polygon input. Frozen before this detector's first replay; no post-result threshold fitting.
failure_rule: Propose possible_drop only when persistent source features show downward image displacement, green/red gap increases and measured jaw opening is nearby. This is an Unverified physical hypothesis; intentional placement, perspective, unrelated red parts and segmentation remain alternatives. No definitive failure without verified task criterion.
